CustomField.formula: IF( CheckIn_CMV__Check_in_Distance__c > CheckIn_CMV__Check_in_Max_Distance_Compliance__c || CheckIn_CMV__Check_out_Distance__c > CheckIn_CMV__Check_out_Max_Distance_Compliance__c, IMAGE("/resource/CheckIn_CMV__error_icon_non_compliant", "Error red X", 25, 25), IMAGE("/resource/CheckIn_CMV__success_icon_compliant", "Green Check", 25, 25) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows if visit is under compliance considering the compliance rules when the visit was done.
CustomField.label: Compliance on Visit
